marker.description: Green-headed dressmaker pin inserted into the anterior surface of the rounded pelvic organ; a blue cannula is also present superiorly.

main_explanation: No question paper is visible and the pin tip lies in a fold of tissue on a large rounded pelvic organ (likely uterus or a uterine/ovarian mass). The intended structure cannot be determined with confidence from the image alone.
review_reason: No legible question paper or station number is present. The specimen appears to be a uterus with an attached large mass and a tubular pedicle, but the exact structure indicated by the green pin is ambiguous (could be myometrium, a fibroid, or the uterine body). The image also appears to be a stacked composite of multiple crops rather than a single clean station photograph.
